character.look: a beautiful young Vietnamese girl of about twenty, petite and very slim: narrow shoulders, thin arms, a small slim waist, a slender neck; a naturally pretty youthful small face with a slim V-shaped jawline, defined cheekbones and a delicate chin, warm dark-brown eyes, light natural makeup, clear even skin in her own natural warm Southeast-Asian tone (not porcelain white), no freckles or spots, long black hair with wispy bangs
character.wardrobe: a muted red outdoor jacket over a cream knit sweater, dark trousers and comfortable walking shoes; the same clothes in every shot
character.manner: She is a real traveller, not a model: relaxed, unhurried natural walking, quiet curiosity, calm natural expression. No posing, no nodding, no waving, no talking, no gestures at the camera, mouth closed. Her hands are graceful: slender fingers, natural skin with real texture, neat clean natural nails, five fingers each, anatomically correct, relaxed natural poses.

plateau.fits: Tibetan plateau and its edge: Shangri-La, Lijiang mountains, Tibet, western Sichuan (Daocheng Yading, Kangding), Qinghai, Gannan
plateau.season_hint: autumn: golden-brown grassland, deep-blue high-altitude sky, crisp sun, first snow on the far peaks
plateau.signature: prayer flags everywhere: strings of colourful lungta flags on passes, shores and roofs, and the giant prayer-flag canopy (tens of thousands of flags on strings from the top of one slender pole down to the ground all around, a huge round tent-like dome; from inside, perfect concentric rings like a giant umbrella, vivid and richly colourful: the five saturated prayer-flag colours (deep blue, white, bright red, green, golden yellow) in bold alternating rings, never faded or pale; a neat tiered cone of layered flags around the pole's foot, never a messy heap of scarves); the giant golden prayer wheel on Guishan Park hill (Dukezong), several storeys tall, embossed with Buddhas, glowing gold at dusk; white stupas, golden-roofed monasteries, prayer wheels, yaks on golden grassland
